text: MsgKeySet sorts ranges by start. Its rebuild step extends cursorEnd only when the new end is greater. Assigning every overlapping range end would lose the tail of a larger containing range. The unit test exercises nested, front-extending and end-extending ranges and the final 1–150 union. This is inclusive numeric range merging; the parser assumes NNTP article numbers and is not a general interval library. This note is based on source inspection. Tests were not run, and full review discussion remains pending.
title: Do not shrink a merged message-key range when another range is contained
